purpose: Correctness and exact executed-row evidence for same-call lower-cut denominator reuse.

scope.reuse_identity: Ordered target partition plus same-call live immutable vectors, parameters/beta, shift and mass slices; source projection retains its separate origin.
scope.fallback: Distinct borrows and standalone calls recompute through the existing Symbolica/native denominator plans.
scope.failure_contract: Buffer shape errors precede writes. A selected parent error may leave stage scratch quotients/statuses written. Published residues and accumulated amplitude results preserve their existing transactional contract.
scope.custom_kernel_compatibility: Additive provided trait method divides, compacts stable target groups, then invokes one existing batched correction call; compact default scratch allocations remain.

coverage: ordinary and native full coefficient equality against default combined implementation
DoubleFloat and Float192 equality plus tracked precision
all higher/mixed Dual components and nonprimal NaN
